# `fluxsim expr`

Parse, check and evaluate one flux-expr/1 expression, or print the model.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`fluxsim expr eval`](#fluxsim-expr-eval) | parse, check and evaluate one expression |
| [`fluxsim expr model`](#fluxsim-expr-model) | print the attrmodel/1 document for a bundle |

## `fluxsim expr eval`

Evaluate one expression against a subject view supplied as JSON.

### Synopsis

```text
fluxsim expr eval [options] <source>
```

### Examples

```bash
# check an expression and evaluate it against one subject
fluxsim expr eval "tenureMonths > 12" --bundle ./bundle \
    --values '{"tenureMonths": 24}'
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `source` | the expression source |

### Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--bundle` | `BUNDLE` | path to the FLUX bundle directory **(required)** |
| `--simulation-id` | `SIMULATION_ID` | which Simulation document to resolve (default: the bundle's only one) |
| `--values` | `VALUES` | a subject view as JSON **(required)** |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |

## `fluxsim expr model`

Print the attribute model an expression in this bundle is checked against.

### Synopsis

```text
fluxsim expr model [options]
```

### Examples

```bash
# every attribute in scope
fluxsim expr model --bundle ./bundle
```

### Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--bundle` | `BUNDLE` | path to the FLUX bundle directory **(required)** |
| `--simulation-id` | `SIMULATION_ID` | which Simulation document to resolve (default: the bundle's only one) |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
